parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how an action potential arriving at a presynaptic neurone can result in the release of acetylcholine into the synaptic cleft.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Lidocaine is a local anaesthetic drug which blocks voltage-gated $Na^+$ channels in the postsynaptic membrane of a synapse.

Explain the effect of lidocaine action on the postsynaptic neurone.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Fig. 8.1 is a diagram of a neuromuscular junction.

{{figure:figure_8_1.png}}
parts.text: With reference to Fig. 8.1, name structures **A**, **B** and **C**.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Outline the importance of structure **A** in the transmission of nerve impulses.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why the structures labelled **C** are needed in a neuromuscular junction.
